distribution.narrative: Smith et al. (2020) records Chongqing and Guizhou. Beaver & Liu (2010) adds the first Taiwan record from Nantou, Hui Son. Smith et al. (2022) independently reports Chongqing, Guizhou and Taiwan, supporting the existing reviewed distribution without changing it.

host_note: Current promoted hosts remain Shorea; Vatica; Lithocarpus from Smith et al. (2020). Beaver & Liu (2010) provides independent historical/source host context. Smith et al. (2022) provides no host in the curated record, so the current host synthesis is unchanged.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Diuncus ciliatoformis (Schedl, 1953).

taxonomic_history.name: Diuncus ciliatoformis
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: Smith et al. (2020) reinstates Diuncus ciliatoformis as a species. Beaver & Liu (2010) notes a proposed synonymy with Diuncus justus but does not accept it; this is retained as taxonomic context only. Stable identity VSN_2386 remains unchanged.
